description: The Librarians confront threats to the foundations of the Library while questions about tethering, Nicole Noone's history and whether only one Librarian can remain force the team to decide what the institution actually requires of them.

s04e01.description: A Vatican sect uncovers a map to the four cornerstones of the ancient Library of Alexandria, and the Librarians race to stop those stones being used to destroy the modern Library.

s04e02.description: An epidemic of impossible bad luck points to a casino owner stealing fortune through a magical artifact, leaving the team to reverse the flow before misfortune spreads beyond the gamblers.

s04e03.description: With Santa away, Ezekiel's criminal mother steals the magic door and triggers a confrontation involving Santa's sleigh, the Patron Saint of Thieves and the survival of Christmas.

s04e04.description: Flynn and Baird are pulled into a classic film-noir world, forcing the Librarians to master the logic of movie genres before the fictional setting traps them permanently.

s04e05.description: Flynn meets legendary former Librarian Darrington Dare when an old enemy resurfaces, but the admired predecessor brings a warning that the Library may not tolerate multiple Librarians forever.

s04e06.description: Baird follows Nicole Noone on a hunt for an artifact targeted by Russian grave robbers and is forced to reconsider what a Guardian sacrifices when loyalty to the Library becomes absolute.

s04e07.description: With the team splintering, Baird takes everyone to a self-help retreat beside a forest where people have vanished, and the forced exercise becomes a real supernatural investigation.

s04e08.description: Cassandra retreats to a town advertised as the safest place in America after freezing on a mission, only to discover its unnatural peace depends on a hidden magical cost.

s04e09.description: Ghosts disrupt a Civil War reenactment in the town of Feud, and the Librarians must uncover the real history behind an old local conflict before the haunting repeats it.

s04e10.description: Jenkins accidentally swaps bodies with a young slacker named Jeff and must recruit Jeff's tabletop-gaming friends to reach the Library before his temporary replacement causes irreversible damage.

s04e11.description: The Library forces the team into a nightmare trial meant to choose a single Librarian, stripping away their usual identities until rivalry threatens both their humanity and Jenkins's life.

s04e12.description: Baird awakens in a reality where the Library never existed and must find the scattered Librarians, restore their memories and reverse a world that has been reshaped without accumulated knowledge.
